title: Local injective of the stage presheaf comparison
statement: Let I be a nonempty directed preorder, D : I^op → Scheme a system of qcqs schemes with affine transition morphisms, c a limiting cone, i₀ a fixed index, and G a sheaf of sets on D(i₀) [def-weil-pbc-sets-section-comparison]. On the full affine étale site J of D(i₀) [def-weil-pbc-full-affine-etale-site], let E be any diagram indexed by (Over(op i₀))^op whose objects are the restricted stage push-pull sheaves A_j = (f_j)_* f_j^{-1}G, whose maps are the canonical section comparisons, and let K be a cocone with point L = p_* p^{-1}G and canonical comparison legs. Let Q be the colimit in presheaves of the underlying presheaves of E, and let a : Q → L be the unique presheaf morphism induced by the legs of K. Then a is locally injective: for every affine étale test object W and x,y in Q(W) with a_W(x)=a_W(y), the sieve of arrows V → W on which the restrictions of x and y agree is J-covering. This is only the equality part of the comparison; it asserts no existence of a preimage.

source.place: Tag 0A35, equation-compute-pullback-to-limit, equality part; affine etale application in Etale Cohomology Tag 09YQ

proof.text: Work on the cofinal upper tail of i₀. A section of the presheaf colimit on W is represented by a section of a stage push-pull sheaf on W; two such sections can be placed at one common stage by directedness. The supplied object and component equalities identify these representatives and their images with the canonical inverse-image section comparisons.

Use the affine-site colimit presentation and transport across full-affine restriction, preserving adjunction units. In the inverse-image description of Sites 0A35, equality of the two limit images is witnessed locally by equalities between representatives in the defining filtered colimits. Each witness uses finitely many objects, arrows and equations. The object, arrow and eventual-equality clauses of the site presentation descend these data together to a common later stage.

Coverings in the limit affine site have finite stage presentations. Descend the coverings witnessing equality, moving all their finitely many data to a common stage. The sheaf separatedness axiom there identifies the two descended sections. The filtered-colimit equality criterion identifies their images in the presheaf colimit. This is the equality part of 0A35's displayed section formula; its unit equation identifies the maps with the maps specified in the hypotheses.

On each test object the two presheaf sections therefore agree (in particular they agree on a covering sieve), which is local injectivity. The empty-object case uses the empty covering and the uniqueness of a sheaf section there; it requires no chosen section of G.

mathlib_searches.query: Local representatives and local eventual equality of sections of inverse images of etale sheaves in limits of schemes
The presheaf colimit of push pull sheaves of sets at stages of a limit of schemes maps locally injectively and locally surjectively to the limit push pull sheaf
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits include PresheafedSpace.pushforwardDiagramToColimit, colimit_presheaf, and Zariski representability local injectivity. None gives the etale inverse-image limit comparison.

mathlib_searches.query: Presheaf.IsLocallyInjective|Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective; rg stage comparisons in lean/WeilConjectures and lean/Sheaf; blueprint search local representatives and local eventual equality
mathlib_searches.results: Mathlib has the general local comparison and sheafification APIs. Project section continuity and affine eventual equality depend on the current item and cannot be imported (import_direction.py reports the cycle). Blueprint searches return zero exact matches. ColimitSites is stated for Cat.{u,u} and Type u; the affine site presentation uses Cat.{u,u+1} and this coefficient sheaf uses Type (u+1), requiring transport rather than a direct application.

theorem etaleSetStagePresheaf_locallyInjective
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u})
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, CompactSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ {i j : Iᵒᵖ} (a : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map a)]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c) (i₀ : I)
    (G : Sheaf (D.obj (op i₀)).smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1))) :
    let ρ := (Scheme.fullAffineEtaleInclusion (D.obj (op i₀))).sheafPushforwardContinuous
      (Type (u + 1)) (Scheme.fullAffineEtaleTopology (D.obj (op i₀)))
      (D.obj (op i₀)).smallEtaleTopology
    let A := fun j : Over (op i₀) ↦ ρ.obj
      (((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (D.map j.hom)).sheafPushforwardContinuous
        (Type (u + 1)) ((D.obj (op i₀)).smallGrothendieckTopology (P := @Etale) (Q := @Etale))
        ((D.obj j.left).smallGrothendieckTopology (P := @Etale) (Q := @Etale))).obj
          ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback (D.map j.hom)).obj G))
    let L := ρ.obj
      ((@Functor.sheafPushforwardContinuous _ _ _ _
        (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (c.π.app (op i₀)))
        (Type (u + 1)) _ ((D.obj (op i₀)).smallGrothendieckTopology (P := @Etale) (Q := @Etale))
        (c.pt.smallGrothendieckTopology (P := @Etale) (Q := @Etale))
        (Etale.isContinuous_overPullback (c.π.app (op i₀)))).obj
          ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback (c.π.app (op i₀))).obj G))
    ∀ (E : (Over (op i₀))ᵒᵖ ⥤
        Sheaf (Scheme.fullAffineEtaleTopology (D.obj (op i₀))) (Type (u + 1)))
      (K : Cocone E),
      (∀ j : Over (op i₀), E.obj (op j) = A j) → K.pt = L →
      (∀ (j k : Over (op i₀)) (a : k ⟶ j)
        (W : (D.obj (op i₀)).FullAffineEtale),
        Arrow.mk ((E.map a.op).hom.app (op W)) =
          Arrow.mk (etaleSetSectionComparison (D.map a.left) (D.map j.hom) (D.map k.hom)
            ((D.map_comp a.left j.hom).symm.trans
              (congrArg (fun t : k.left ⟶ op i₀ ↦ D.map t) a.w)) G W.obj)) →
      (∀ (j : Over (op i₀)) (W : (D.obj (op i₀)).FullAffineEtale),
        Arrow.mk ((K.ι.app (op j)).hom.app (op W)) =
          Arrow.mk (etaleSetSectionComparison (c.π.app j.left) (D.map j.hom)
            (c.π.app (op i₀)) (c.w j.hom) G W.obj)) →
      Presheaf.IsLocallyInjective
      (Scheme.fullAffineEtaleTopology (D.obj (op i₀)))
      (colimit.desc
        (E ⋙ sheafToPresheaf (Scheme.fullAffineEtaleTopology (D.obj (op i₀)))
          (Type (u + 1)))
        ((sheafToPresheaf (Scheme.fullAffineEtaleTopology (D.obj (op i₀)))
          (Type (u + 1))).mapCocone K))
